title: Celestial Realm's Turbulence
next_chapter_hook: Two figures almost simultaneously stepped into the Dao Hall where Chen Ji resided—one a messenger from the imperial court, the other a commander of the Demonic Path. When the two forces met, their animosity burned like fire. Chen Ji sat calmly at the head seat, the corner of his lips curling slightly upward—the show... had only just begun.

text.content: That cold snort rang like thunder through the ears, yet Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, as if that transcendent gaze beyond mortal comprehension was merely a gentle breeze brushing past. The Tianji Record Fragment trembled slightly within his Mental Sea, as if conveying some kind of warning, or perhaps mocking that so-called lofty superiority. "Look then," he murmured in his heart, "since you're watching, watch your fill." He rose slowly, his aura like still waters in an abyss, unfathomably deep. Quasi-Heavenly Dao-level pressure spread silently in all directions,震慑ing all the insignificant pests around.

dialogue.content: Little one, that one is not easy to provoke. The remnant soul of Mo Xiansheng drifted faintly, his voice carrying a hint of gravity, "Though... you're more composed than this old man imagined."

text.content: A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips: "Rest assured, Senior, I never fight battles I'm unprepared for." Before his words even finished, his perception extended outward like a tidal wave. At the edge of the Celestial Realm, numerous forces were stirring restlessly, all probing the bottom line of this newly risen powerhouse. A cold glint flashed in his eyes—if they wanted to gauge his depth, then let them see clearly—but the price after seeing... was something they couldn't afford to pay.

dialogue.content: Let's go, let's meet these... overly eager "friends."

text.content: At the edge of the Celestial Realm, a faction known as the "Xuanming Palace" had been entrenched for ages. Its Palace Master, Xuanming True Person, was an old-level powerhouse at the half-step Quasi-Heavenly Dao stage. At this moment, he sat upright in the main seat, while several scouts knelt below him, their brows furrowed. "That newly risen powerhouse, is he truly just a wandering cultivator?" Before the words even finished, a light laugh suddenly echoed from outside the main hall. "Xuanming Daoist friend, why don't I answer that question myself?" Chen Ji's figure, hands clasped behind his back, abruptly appeared outside the hall entrance.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stepped into the main hall, his gaze sweeping across Xuanming True Person's suddenly rigid aged face. He spoke softly: "I've heard your palace is quite interested in me? What a coincidence—I rather enjoy befriending... interesting friends." With each step he took, golden Dao patterns spread beneath his feet, the pressure like mountains collapsing. Xuanming True Person's face turned deathly pale, cold sweat beading on his forehead. Quasi-Heavenly Dao-level might—this was no wandering cultivator at all, but a being capable of crushing him!

text.content: Xuanming True Person forced a smile, struggling to his feet to bow: "Senior jests, we merely..." Before he could finish, Chen Ji raised his hand. A sword qi swept across the hall, striking the ground just three inches beside Xuanming True Person, leaving a bottomless fissure. "I have one bad habit," Chen Ji said with a smiling face, "I don't like listening to nonsense." Xuanming True Person's Adam's apple bobbed, his voice trembling: "Senior... what are your orders?"

News spread like wildfire across the edges of the Celestial Realm—in merely three days, Chen Ji had swept through seventeen factions, with none able to withstand a single exchange. What chilled hearts even more was that he never killed indiscriminately; he only forced those faction leaders, right before his eyes, to personally destroy evidence of their collusion with the Demonic Path, then... let them go. Fear grips longer than slaughter ever could. "Senior's move is truly masterful," a faction scout reported while still trembling all over upon returning.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji sat upright in the temporarily constructed Dao Hall, before him knelt the fifth batch of envoys come to show favor. He didn't even lift his eyelids, merely toying with the Jade Slip in his hand as he said indifferently: "Another one here to pledge loyalty? Speak then—what can your master offer me?" The envoy stammered out a lengthy list of resources. After Chen Ji finished listening, he finally showed a hint of satisfaction. "Not bad. Go back and tell your master, I've noted this favor."

choice.prompt: All factions are showing favor—how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Accept all, cast a wide net
choices.description: Accept allegiance from all factions equally, give surface-level promises on the outside, secretly record each one's leverage, building an extensive intelligence network.
choices.visible_cost: Requires scattered energy to maintain multiple relationship lines
choices.visible_reward: Intelligence network coverage is extremely broad, all factions' movements under complete grasp
choices.risk_hint: Making too many enemies may attract vigilance from larger powers

text.content: Chen Ji smiled as he accepted all submissions, yet when no one was watching, a sharp glint flashed in his gaze—these people, someday, would all be chess pieces.

choices.text: Select allies carefully, forge deep cooperation
choices.description: From the numerous factions, select three with the most potential to establish deep alliances; with other factions, maintain only surface-level interactions, focusing resources to build a core circle.
choices.visible_reward: Core allies have high loyalty, powerful assistance can be mobilized at critical moments
choices.risk_hint: Few allies mean relatively weaker risk-resistance

text.content: Chen Ji personally met with the leaders of three factions. After heartfelt conversations, all three departed with flushed faces—receiving such attention from this rising star, how could they not achieve greatness together?

choices.text: Accept all, exchange at equal value
choices.description: Accept all submissions, but make it clear: all benefits are clearly priced. If you want protection, you must pay the real price—no empty courtesies accepted.
choices.visible_reward: Solid accumulation of resources, establishing an unshakeable alliance of interests
choices.risk_hint: Being overly pragmatic may cause some factions to become resentful

text.content: The envoys exchanged glances—this Senior was truly different indeed. Not seeking false fame, only real benefits. After a moment, with respect outweighing reluctance, chest after chest of heavenly treasures flowed into the Dao Hall.

dialogue.content: Just then, a familiar demonic aura stealthily seeped into the Dao Hall. Ye Qing's form condensed in the shadows, her expression carrying rare solemnity: "Chen Ji, long time no see." She paused, her voice pressed extremely low, "There's intelligence—the Demonic Path Commander and the Imperial Court have both sent envoys, rushing toward the Celestial Realm. Within three days, they'll arrive simultaneously."

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered slightly as he took the Jade Slip from Ye Qing, his divine sense probing within. After a moment, a meaningful smile curved his lips: "The Demonic Path Commander sent his trusted left envoy? And the Imperial Court side... even sent the Crown Prince personally?" He laughed lightly, "Interesting—it seems my movements these past days have indeed made certain people unable to sit still."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing furrowed her brow: "What do you plan to do? That is the Demonic Path Commander's trusted aide, supposedly a Quasi-Heavenly Dao peak expert. And though the Crown Prince's cultivation is inferior to his, behind him stands the entire Imperial Court's resources..." Chen Ji raised a hand to interrupt her: "Ye Qing, do you believe me—right now, I more than either of them wants to know what cards they hold?" A sharp glint flashed in his eyes, "This is the value of an information advantage."

choice.prompt: The Demonic Path Commander and Imperial Court envoys are about to arrive simultaneously—how should Chen Ji position his pieces?

choices.description: Before both parties arrive, separately leak intelligence about one party to the other, making them come with suspicion, unable to form a united front.
choices.visible_cost: Requires precise control over timing and content of information leaks
choices.visible_reward: Both parties become suspicious of each other, Chen Ji can profit from the middle
choices.risk_hint: Once exposed, will simultaneously offend both major forces

text.content: Chen Ji's slender fingers tapped lightly on the Jade Slip several times, countless messages quietly dispatched. A faint smile curved his lips: "Let the bullet fly a while."

choices.description: Make no additional moves, simply wait for both parties to arrive. Adapt to the changing situation with constancy, reveal true strength at the negotiating table.
choices.visible_cost: Abandoning information advantage may lead to passivity
choices.visible_reward: Displays calm confidence, leaving both parties with the impression of someone not to be provoked
choices.risk_hint: May miss the optimal positioning timing

text.content: After Ye Qing departed, Chen Ji closed his eyes to rest, yet his divine sense sank into the Tianji Record, peering into possible developments over the next three hours. This time, he was格外谨慎.

choices.description: Without waiting for their arrival, directly intercept both envoys at their必经之路, showcasing an unshakeable position through absolute strength.
choices.visible_reward: Strike first to dominate, establishing dominant position before formal negotiations
choices.risk_hint: If the other party has hidden trump cards, may fall into passivity

text.content: Chen Ji rose, swept his sleeves, and Quasi-Heavenly Dao-level pressure radiated outward like a tide in all directions. "Since they want to see me, let them know—who I am."

Three days passed in a flash. During these three days, the submissions, resources, and intelligence Chen Ji received piled like mountains. He accepted everything, yet secretly investigated every faction's bottom line. The Tianji Record Fragment radiated gentle warmth, those predicted scenes flashing endlessly through his mind—two figures, almost simultaneously stepping into the Dao Hall. The Imperial Court envoys' gorgeous robes and the Demonic Path left envoy's sinister demonic aura, intersecting beneath the same sky.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji opened his eyes, a playful arc curving his lips. He rose to straighten his robes, leisurely walking toward the Dao Hall's gate. "Everyone—" His voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly entered every ear present, "Today's show, how should it begin?" Before the words even finished, two extraordinary rainbows appeared simultaneously on the horizon outside the Dao Hall.

choice.prompt: Both envoys are about to arrive—how should Chen Ji choose his entrance?

choices.text: Dominate from above, let them come to audience
choices.description: Sit upright at the main seat of the Dao Hall, letting both envoys come in to audience on their own, controlling the overall situation from a host's position.
choices.visible_cost: May be considered arrogant and discourteous
choices.visible_reward: Establish absolute dominant position, both parties must look up to speak to him
choices.risk_hint: If the other party is proud and stubborn, may immediately storm off in anger

text.content: Chen Ji returned to the main seat, crossed his legs, his aura like深潭锁波, still as death. When the two extraordinary rainbows descended, what they saw was this scene—the legendary rising star, looking at them with a knowing smile.

choices.description: Lower his posture, personally welcome both envoys at the gate, displaying the virtue of respecting the worthy.
choices.visible_cost: May be seen as weak and easily bullied
choices.visible_reward: Both envoys feel valued, convenient for future manipulation
choices.risk_hint: Being overly courteous may embolden the other party to overstep

text.content: Chen Ji actually walked to the Dao Hall's entrance, personally welcoming both envoys. Both parties were somewhat surprised—this rising star was so easy to get along with? Only Ye Qing sighed faintly in the shadows—the fellow is acting again.

choices.description: First receive the Imperial Court envoys, seating them in the upper seat; then meet the Demonic Path left envoy, deliberately leaving them waiting a moment, making them suspicious of each other.
choices.visible_cost: Requires precise balance between warmth and coldness
choices.visible_reward: Both parties become suspicious of each other's special treatment, convenient for Chen Ji to defeat each separately
choices.risk_hint: If the intention is seen through, may offend both sides simultaneously

text.content: When the Imperial Court envoys were guided to the upper seat, the Demonic Path left envoy was still waiting outside the gate. Chen Ji held his tea cup, smiling graciously: "Crown Prince, please." Outside the door, the Demonic Path left envoy's face had already darkened to the color of water.

Two figures almost simultaneously stepped into the Dao Hall—one dressed in gold-trimmed brocade robes, regal aura flowing around them, precisely the Imperial Court Crown Prince; the other cloaked in black robes, sinister demonic energy surrounding them, precisely the trusted left envoy of the Demonic Path Commander. When the two forces met, their animosity burned like fire. The Crown Prince snorted coldly: "Demonic Path remnants, how dare you appear here?" The Demonic Path left envoy gave a sinister laugh: "Crown Prince, what mighty airs—but it seems the host here hasn't spoken yet."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji sat at the main seat, watching this scene, a satisfied light flickering in his eyes. He slowly set down his tea cup, chuckling: "Both of you traveled far—why must we be so tense?" He gestured to the left and right sides, "Crown Prince, please sit here. Left Envoy, please sit there. Today in my place, we don't discuss factions, only... interests." The words fell, and both parties' gazes simultaneously focused on this newly risen powerhouse. And Chen Ji, simply smiled genially at them, as if everything was under his complete control.

text.content: Inside the Dao Hall, the atmosphere momentarily froze. The Imperial Court Crown Prince and the Demonic Path left envoy exchanged glances, yet actually took their seats separately. Their accompanying attendants were all elite, yet none dared act rashly. Chen Ji surveyed the surroundings, taking in everyone's expressions. The Tianji Record in his Mental Sea burned slightly warmer, that gaze from the Celestial Realm seeming to grow even more intense. He sneered in his heart—want to watch a show? Then watch your fill. He raised his tea cup, slightly saluting both parties: "Everyone, please." The show, officially began.
